title: A pattern in the sky
body:
A **constellation** helps us name a region of the sky.

The picture we trace is a view from Earth. Its stars need not be near one another in space.

title: A star with a warm colour
body:
Betelgeuse is a **red supergiant**. Its reddish appearance is one clue to the kind of star it is.

For now, remember just the name and its place in Orion.
